nl: Update the copyright line 'Copyright 2025 Example Ltd.' to 'Copyright 2026 Example Ltd.' in all .py files under src/, including src/gen/table5.py. Other years and other numbers stay unchanged.

forbidden.reason: the license text is not a source file

oracle_program: search "Copyright 2025 Example Ltd." "src" glob: "**/*.py" mode: literal |> replace "Copyright 2026 Example Ltd."
reference_bash: grep -rlF --include='*.py' 'Copyright 2025 Example Ltd.' src | xargs -r sed -i 's/Copyright 2025 Example Ltd\./Copyright 2026 Example Ltd./'
